description: Auto-format markdown on Write/Edit; leftover lint issues are reported as non-blocking context

hooks.command: input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | jq -e '(.tool_input.file_path // "") | endswith(".md")' >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | bash "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/mdlint.sh"; fi
